about.title: About Me
about.p1: I'm a Machine Learning Engineer focused on turning data into dependable, production-minded systems. My work spans classical ML, computer vision, and generative AI, with an emphasis on retrieval-augmented generation and practical AI automation.
about.p2: I care about the full lifecycle: framing the problem, engineering the data, choosing the right model, and shipping it behind a clean API with monitoring in mind. I enjoy problems where reliability and grounding matter as much as raw model performance.
about.p3: The assistant on this site is a live example: a real RAG pipeline that answers questions about my background using only my own knowledge base.
